text: UnDeclareNonCommutative[a, b, ...] undeclares a,b, ... to be noncommutative, i.e., DataType[a,b, ..., NonCommutative] is set to False.
As a side-effect of DeclareNonCommutative x is declared to be of DataType NonCommutative.
DeclareNonCommutative[y, z] DataType[y, z, NonCommutative] ```mathematica $$\{\text{True},\text{True}\}$$ ```mathematica UnDeclareNonCommutative[y, z] DataType[y, z, NonCommutative]
